program='''def transform(grid):
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    n = len(colors)
    top = grid[0][0]
    lower = grid[1][0]

    def step(start, offset):
        return colors[(colors.index(start) + offset) % n]

    out = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        out_row = []
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if r == 0 or c > r:
                out_row.append(step(top, c))
            else:
                out_row.append(step(lower, min(c, r - 1)))
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
print(p.read_text())
